Luxury Serviced Apartments in Tokyo

YOUR URBAN OASIS IN THE HEART OF THE CITY

Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo offers an elegant urban retreat in Marunouchi and Otemachi, Tokyo’s leading business and financial district. With direct covered access to Otemachi Station and Tokyo Station just a 10-minute walk away, the residence places you close to business, culture and some of the city’s most prestigious addresses.

Choose from elegantly appointed serviced apartments, ranging from studios to spacious three-bedroom residences. Designed for both short and extended stays, many apartments feature modern kitchens, washer-dryers and bathtubs, while selected larger units also include traditional tatami spaces for a distinctive local touch.

Guests can also enjoy a range of premium facilities including a 24-hour gymnasium, indoor exercise pool, meeting rooms, business centre, lobby lounge and rooftop terrace. Whether for business or leisure, Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo offers a refined residential stay in the centre of Tokyo.

Our services include a 24-hour reception, flexible housekeeping options, laundry and dry-cleaning services, as well as wellness and security support designed to ensure a comfortable and reassuring stay.

 

Whether you're staying for a night or an extended visit, enjoy the comfort of home with the service and ease of a luxury hotel. Residences feature high-quality furnishings, complimentary Wi-Fi, bathtubs, and modern kitchens in most units, alongside thoughtful amenities designed for everyday living.

Strategically located in the Marunouchi-Otemachi area, Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo will be part of MEC’s prestigious mixed-use development comprising offices and retail outlets. The serviced residence has a prime address in Tokyo’s central business district where multinational companies and the headquarters of major Japanese banks are based.

Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo offers global travellers an urban oasis in the bustling city of Tokyo. Strategically located in the Marunouchi-Otemachi area, one of our latest luxuries Ascott residences will connect you to some of the finer things in the city. 

The serviced residence will be built as part of an integrated development, which plays host to a plethora of shopping, dining and entertainment outlets, including specialty restaurants, cafés and bars with both indoor and alfresco dining options. Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo offers our well-heeled guests various apartment types, ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments. Guests will also be given the option of apartments that come with the signature Japanese tatami mattress for those seeking an authentic experience.

Residences

Sophisticated comfort for short and long stays

At Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo, each of our 130 residences offers a sophisticated blend of comfort and style, ideal for both short and long stays. Thoughtfully designed interiors in rich brown and gold tones create a warm, welcoming atmosphere, complemented by soft lighting and elegant furnishings. Most units are equipped with fully fitted kitchens, washers and dryers, and spacious bathtubs—perfect for extended stays. Whether you are in Tokyo for business or leisure, our residences invite you to experience the city as if it were your home.

Where we are
Serviced Apartments in Marunouchi

Stay in the Heart of Marunouchi, Tokyo’s Prestigious Business and Lifestyle District

Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo enjoys a strategic location in the Marunouchi-Otemachi area, one of Tokyo’s most prestigious districts. Surrounded by major business headquarters, refined dining, designer shopping, cultural landmarks and excellent transport links, the residence is an ideal base for both corporate travellers and discerning leisure guests. 
From the property, guests can easily access Otemachi Station, Tokyo Station, the Imperial Palace, Marunouchi Naka-dori Avenue, Tokyo International Forum, Ginza and Nihonbashi. Whether you are visiting Tokyo for business, an extended stay, luxury shopping, cultural experiences or sightseeing, Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo places the best of central Tokyo within effortless reach.

Direct Subway Access

Directly connected to Otemachi Station via Exit C6a.

Near Tokyo Station

Approximately 10–12 minutes on foot from Tokyo Station.

Imperial Palace Area

Within walking distance of the Imperial Palace gardens and running route.

Ginza & Nihonbashi

Luxury shopping and dining are easily accessible by taxi or subway.

How to Get to Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo

From Haneda Airport
By Airport Limousine Bus: Approximately 45 minutes to Tokyo Station. From Tokyo Station, walk about 12 minutes or take the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line for 1 stop to Otemachi Station, which is directly connected to the residence via Exit C6a.

By Railway: Take the Tokyo Monorail and JR Yamanote Line to Tokyo Station in approximately 30 minutes, followed by a 12-minute walk or a short subway ride to Otemachi Station.

From Narita Airport
By Airport Limousine Bus: Approximately 90 minutes to Tokyo Station. From there, walk about 12 minutes or take the Marunouchi Line to Otemachi Station.

By Narita Express: Approximately 70 minutes to Tokyo Station, followed by a 12-minute walk or a short subway ride to Otemachi Station.

*Travel times are approximate and may vary depending on traffic, train schedules and time of day.

Nearest Public Transport from Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo

Otemachi Station
Direct access from Exit C6a. Served by the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tozai Line, Chiyoda Line, Hanzomon Line and Toei Mita Line.

Tokyo Station
Approximately 10 minutes on foot from Marunouchi North Gate. Served by the JR Yamanote Line, Keihin-Tohoku Line, Chuo Line, Sobu Rapid Line, Yokosuka Line, Keiyo Line and Shinkansen lines.

 Stay in the Heart of Marunouchi, Tokyo’s Prestigious Business and Lifestyle District

Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo enjoys a strategic location in the Marunouchi-Otemachi area, one of Tokyo’s most prestigious districts. Surrounded by major business headquarters, refined dining, designer shopping, cultural landmarks and excellent transport links, the residence is an ideal base for both corporate travellers and discerning leisure guests.
From the property, guests can easily access Otemachi Station, Tokyo Station, the Imperial Palace, Marunouchi Naka-dori Avenue, Tokyo International Forum, Ginza and Nihonbashi. Whether you are visiting Tokyo for business, an extended stay, luxury shopping, cultural experiences or sightseeing, Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo places the best of central Tokyo within effortless reach.

 How to Get to Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo

 From Haneda Airport

 By Airport Limousine Bus: Approximately 45 minutes to Tokyo Station. From Tokyo Station, walk about 12 minutes or take the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line for 1 stop to Otemachi Station, which is directly connected to the residence via Exit C6a.

 By Railway: Take the Tokyo Monorail and JR Yamanote Line to Tokyo Station in approximately 30 minutes, followed by a 12-minute walk or a short subway ride to Otemachi Station.

 From Narita Airport

 By Airport Limousine Bus: Approximately 90 minutes to Tokyo Station. From there, walk about 12 minutes or take the Marunouchi Line to Otemachi Station.

 By Narita Express: Approximately 70 minutes to Tokyo Station, followed by a 12-minute walk or a short subway ride to Otemachi Station.

*Travel times are approximate and may vary depending on traffic, train schedules and time of day.

 Nearest Public Transport from Ascott Marunouchi Tokyo

 Otemachi Station

Direct access from Exit C6a. Served by the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tozai Line, Chiyoda Line, Hanzomon Line and Toei Mita Line.

 Tokyo Station

Approximately 10 minutes on foot from Marunouchi North Gate. Served by the JR Yamanote Line, Keihin-Tohoku Line, Chuo Line, Sobu Rapid Line, Yokosuka Line, Keiyo Line and Shinkansen lines.

Luxury Serviced Apartments in Tokyo

Experience refined city living at Somerset Shinagawa Tokyo, where comfort meets convenience in the exclusive Takanawa neighbourhood. This distinguished residential area offers a tranquil escape whilst remaining moments away from Shinagawa, one of Tokyo's leading business districts. Our prime location ensures you are ideally placed to explore the city's vibrant attractions, renowned shopping, and diverse dining scene, all easily accessible from your doorstep, offering a harmonious balance between city life and serene living.

Our thoughtfully designed serviced apartments cater to every need, ranging from cleverly arranged studios to expansive three-bedroom residences. Each apartment provides a welcoming sanctuary, featuring a fully equipped kitchen and separate living and dining areas, essential for comfortable long-term stays. You will find standard amenities such as air-conditioning, complimentary Wi-Fi, and an in-room electronic safe. A unique offering is the availability of selected pet-friendly apartments, allowing your beloved companions to join you in this luxurious setting.

Beyond your private apartment, a host of facilities and services are available to enhance your time with us. Maintain your fitness routine in our well-appointed gymnasium, or connect with fellow residents in the inviting residents' lounge. We provide weekly housekeeping services, laundry and dry-cleaning options, and secure basement car parking. Our commitment to your peace of mind is reflected in our 24-hour security, CCTV surveillance, and electronic keycard access throughout the property. Guests are encouraged to engage with our community through various residents' programmes designed to enrich your long-term stay.

Our dedicated team is here to ensure your time in Tokyo is exceptional, whether you are visiting for business or leisure, for a short trip or an extended stay. Discover the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience, and make this exclusive residence your sophisticated home away from home.

*Joined Ascott Star Rewards (ASR) in August 2025.

For stays of 30 nights or more , please also visit Monthly Stay & Long Stay Rates in Tokyo (ASR Member Exclusive) .

Shinagawa’s history dates back to the eighth century, when the area once served the Japanese as a post station. Thanks to its centralised location in the heart of Tokyo, Shinagawa was a transit point for goods and people - a role that is reflected in its name, which translates to ‘Goods River’ in Japanese.



Somerset Shinagawa Tokyo is ideally located in Takanawa, an exclusive residential area in Tokyo and just a stone`s throw away from one of the leading business districts, Shinagawa. Shinagawa station, a major railway intersection, is just 7-minute walk away.

From cleverly designed studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, every unit comes with a fully equipped kitchen and an en-suite bathroom furnished with eco-friendly bath amenities. Guests can also enjoy a separate living and dining area, television with satellite and cable channels, air-conditioning, housekeeping services, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

For your convenience, all apartments are fully furnished with bedding and essential amenities, including a full-sized kitchen with dishwasher, washer-dryer, hairdryer, iron, and in-room safe. You can settle in and feel at home from the very first day of your stay.

Luxury Serviced Apartment in Tokyo

Experience the height of luxury at Oakwood Premier Tokyo, a distinguished serviced apartment residence ideally positioned near Tokyo Station within the prestigious Marunouchi Tokyo district. The property’s direct underground access to Tokyo Station ensures seamless connections across the city and beyond. From here, you can easily reach the bustling Marunouchi business district, explore the serene Imperial East Gardens, or indulge in retail therapy within the renowned Ginza shopping area.

Our residence, occupying the 6th to 19th floors of the modern Tekko Building, features 120 stylish, fully furnished apartments. Oakwood Premier Tokyo Midtown

Luxury Serviced Apartments in Tokyo

Experience refined city living at Oakwood Premier Tokyo Midtown, a collection of luxury serviced apartments designed for discerning guests. Situated within the prestigious Tokyo Midtown complex in the vibrant Roppongi district, our residence provides an exceptional base for extended stays, business trips, and leisure travel. You will find yourself directly connected to Roppongi Station (on the Hibiya and Oedo subway lines) for effortless exploration across the city. Within Tokyo Midtown, you have immediate access to a stylish supermarket, the extensive Galleria shopping mall, international restaurants, and the Tokyo Midtown Clinic.

Choose from our 107 meticulously designed residences, ranging from comfortable studios to expansive three-bedroom apartments, each harmonising Japanese aesthetics with classic elegance. Our apartments are ideal for those requiring a minimum stay of one month, offering a true home away from home. Every residence features a modern, fully equipped kitchen complete with a dishwasher and, crucially for longer stays, an in-room washer-dryer. Step out onto your private balcony to enjoy captivating city views, complemented by complimentary Wi-Fi and daily housekeeping.

Beyond your private sanctuary, Oakwood Premier Tokyo Midtown offers a comprehensive suite of facilities and services to enhance your stay. Maintain your routine at our 24-hour Fitness Centre, conveniently located on the lobby floor. The Residents' Lounge, often considered the soul of our community, provides a welcoming space for relaxation and socialising. For your professional needs, the "Genesis" Meeting Room accommodates up to eight persons for private discussions or presentations. Our dedicated 24-hour reception team is always on hand to assist you with concierge services and travel arrangements.

Additional conveniences include comprehensive business centre services, professional laundry and dry cleaning services, and secure carparking (available for a fee). We ensure a safe environment with 24-hour security and CCTV. For families, a children's play area is available, and we welcome pets upon request, with applicable charges. Discover an elevated expression of luxury city living at Oakwood Premier Tokyo Midtown, where tranquillity and security meet the vibrant energy of the city.

*Minimum 1-month stay.

Exclusively catered to deliver inimitable longer stay* experiences, Oakwood Premier Tokyo Midtown offers breathtaking views of the city and elevated living across 107 luxurious apartments that marry Japanese aesthetics with classic décor. As part of the stunning Tokyo Midtown development in Roppongi with direct access to Roppongi Station, guests are perfectly located and connected to key business sites, Tokyo Midtown Medical Center and Tokyo Midtown Galleria shopping mall. Overlooking the beautiful Tokyo Midtown Park, bask in the splendor of your private haven that redefines luxurious living.

*minimum 1-month stay

For booking inquiries, please connect with us via the Central Reservations Office at +81-3-6890-6631, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 4:30 pm.

Offering the luxury of privacy, the residences are ideal for extended stays, providing the warmth and comfort of home.

At Oakwood Hotel & Apartments Azabu, Tokyo, we offer a variety of facilities to ensure a refined and comfortable stay. Where we are
Oakwood Residence Roppongi T-Cube Tokyo offers an enviable address in the heart of Roppongi, one of Tokyo's most international and dynamic districts. This central location places you amidst a thriving hub of global businesses, diverse dining, and cultural attractions. Roppongi is renowned for its cosmopolitan atmosphere, blending high-end shopping and art galleries with a lively entertainment scene. The residence benefits from a direct connection to Roppongi-Itchome Metro Station, which serves the Namboku Line, ensuring seamless and efficient urban access.

 The location offers excellent proximity to major city landmarks. Roppongi Station, serving both the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line and the Toei Oedo Line, is approximately 800 metres away. This proximity facilitates effortless travel to key areas: Shinjuku is reachable in approximately 9 minutes via the Toei Oedo Line, while Shibuya is accessible in 9 to 10 minutes via a single transfer. Furthermore, for connections to major transport hubs, Tokyo Station is just a 12-minute subway ride away, ensuring you are exceptionally well-connected for business or exploring Tokyo's many sights.

- By Train: Approximately 40 minutes (via the Keikyu Line, Toei Asakusa Line, and Tokyo Metro Namboku Line to Roppongi-itchome Station)

- By Car: Approximately 90 minutes.

- By Limousine Bus: Approximately 120 minutes (alight at Roppongi Hills, then 5–10 minutes by walk or taxi).

Where we are
Oakwood Residence Shinagawa Tokyo is strategically located in the heart of the Shinagawa Central Business District, a dynamic neighbourhood that blends modern office complexes with diverse dining and shopping. Our residence is an 8-minute walk from JR Shinagawa Station via a convenient pedestrian Skyway, ensuring immediate access to the entire city. Within the station complex, you can explore Ecute Shinagawa and Atre Shinagawa for a variety of shops and eateries, or browse the retail options at Queens Isetan.
 The surrounding area offers a wealth of attractions and leisure pursuits. For entertainment, Maxell Aqua Park Shinagawa provides an engaging experience, while the historic Shinagawa Shrine and the serene Gotenyama Garden offer cultural and relaxing escapes, all within a short distance. The artistic district of Tennozu Isle is also a short distance away, featuring galleries and waterfront dining. This prime location, on the Konan side of the station, is ideally placed to access both the financial centre and popular entertainment areas.

Getting to Oakwood Residence Shinagawa Tokyo
From Haneda International Airport (HND):

 By Taxi/Private Transfer: Approximately 20 to 30 minutes drive.
 By Train: The Keikyū Main Line offers direct routes, with the journey taking approximately 15 minutes.

 From Narita International Airport (NRT):

 By Taxi/Private Transfer: The journey typically takes around 60 to 90 minutes, depending on traffic.
 By Train: Easily reached via the Narita Express from Shinagawa Station.

Nearest public transport from Oakwood Residence Shinagawa Tokyo
JR Shinagawa Station: Just an 8-minute walk from our doorstep (via Pedestrian Skyway). This hub serves major lines (Yamanote, Tōkaidō) and the Shinkansen (bullet train) network.

SUMI (approx. 0.5 km)

Official brand FAQ (https://mimaruhotels.com/en/faq/ 2026-08-16), linked from the official hotel page:

What time is check-in/check out?
・Check-in time: From 3:00PM
・Check-out time: Until 11:00AM
Please note that check-outs outside of the above times will incur a fee. We may not be able to accommodate your request depending on room availability.

Can I check in early?
If you room is ready, you can check in earlier than 15:00.However, this depends on the room availability on your check-in day, and we are not able to promise an early check-in.

Can I check out late?
Late check-out is available for an additional fee of JPY 3,000 per hour between 11:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
Please note that late check-out is subject to room availability on the day of departure and may not always be possible.

Can I check in late?
Check-in after 22:00 is possible, but please let the location know beforehand that you will be checking in late.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I store my luggage before check-in and/or after check-out?
We will store your luggage free of charge between 7:00 and 22:00 on your check-in and check-out days.
Please let the front staff know if you would like to store your luggage.
Please note that, due to our limited storage space, there is an additional charge of 500 yen per piece of luggage per day for storing luggage outside of the above hours and days.
We cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.
Depending on the space available at the time of your request, we may not be able to accommodate your wish for luggage storage, so please contact each location directly for the details.

Do you provide luggage shipping services?
It is possible to send your luggage and belongings to the location in advance.
Please make sure of the following when sending:
・Use your MIMARU reservation name for sending. This is required so we know the delivery belongs to you.
・We recommend setting a designated delivery date and arranging the arrival date to be after your check-in date. If your luggage arrives before this date, additional storage fees may apply.
Additionally, please note that we cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.

What internet services do you provide?
Every room comes equipped with free Wi-Fi.
Wi-Fi login details are available at check-in.

Is there a humidifier available in each room?
There is a two-in-one air purifying humidifier in each guest room.

I have a nursing infant who is still on baby formula. Is there a way for me to heat water in my room?
All guest rooms are equipped with an electric kettle.

Do you offer baby crib rental services?
For child safety reasons, we only provide free baby crib services for infants ages 2 below. If you wish to reserve a crib, please make a note on your reservation in the comments section when booking. Please understand in advance that we have a limited number of cribs at each facility.

How are children counted towards room capacity?
Up to 2 children who are of the age of 6 or under at the time of check-in will not be counted towards adult capacity and can share a bed with an adult.

Are all rooms non-smoking?
All MIMARU rooms are non-smoking.
Please consider using the designated smoking areas if you would like to smoke.
We kindly ask for your cooperation so families with small children staying at MIMARU can have a safe trip.

Does MIMARU provide amenities?
Each MIMARU location provides shampoo, conditioner, body soap, face and hand soap, dishwashing detergent, kitchen paper, dish sponges, deodorant spray, tissue paper, coffee, and tea bags.
To help protect the environment, we request that you bring your own amenities such as own toothbrushes and slippers. Please inquire at the front desk if these items are needed.

What type of room cleaning services do you provide?
Daily cleaning involves replacing bath towels, face towels, and bath mats, in addition to vacuuming.
During your stay, cleaning services will be provided every two days starting from the third day (excluding the check-in day). The bathroom and all areas except the kitchen will be cleaned, and the beds will be made.
Should you need additional cleaning services (subject to an additional charge), kindly notify the front desk staff ahead of time.

Do you provide breakfast services?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not provide breakfast service.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Does each hotel have a restaurant?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not feature restaurants.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Do you provide room service?
No, we do not provide room service. Please inquire at the hotel reception for dining recommendations in the vicinity of the hotel. Guests are permitted to use food delivery and take-out services at our hotels.

Is there a gym?
A gym is available only at MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo and MIMARU Osaka Namba Station.
For more details, please refer to each hotel’s official webpage.

Do you offer coin laundries?
Coin laundries are available 24/7 at almost all of our locations except the ones that feature a washing machine/dryer in all rooms.
In-room washing machines are available at the following locations and room types:
Tokyo:
MIMARU Tokyo Station East → Any Room with “Suite” in the Name
MIMARU Tokyo Ikebukuro → Any Room with “Suite” in the Name
MIMARU SUITES Tokyo Asakusa → All Rooms
MIMARU SUITES Tokyo Nihonbashi → All Rooms

Are there parking lots at your facilities?
MIMARU does not offer dedicated parking lots. If you plan on arriving by car, please inquire at the front desk so our staff can direct you to a nearby parking space. For more parking information, check the “Nearby parking” information at the bottom of each location’s website.
*Guests will have to provide their own parking fees.

Do you provide shuttle bus services from the airport to your hotels?
Unfortunately, we do not provide shuttle bus services.

Are minors allowed to book and stay at MIMARU hotels without being accompanied by an adult?
For minors wishing to stay at MIMARU, we require your parent(s) or guardian(s) to fill out and sign our Consent Form for Underage Accommodation using a touchscreen device.
The personal information you provide will be limited to the sole purpose of receiving the consent of your parent(s) and/or guardian(s).

Can my travel companion check in before me?
Yes, this is possible. Please provide the front desk with the name on the reservation when checking in. Please note that we will be required to confirm the identity of anyone checking in afterwards.

If I change the number of people staying, will my reservation price change as well?
If the new number of guests is still within room capacity, there will be no change in reservation price.
Please contact your reserved MIMARU if you would like to change the number of people staying in your room.

Can I change my check-in date?
You can change reservations that were made through our official website yourself.
However, please note that, depending on room availablity, you may not be able to change to your desired dates.
Additionally, please keep in mind that a price change may occur as each location’s room rates change daily.

How can I get a receipt?
Receipts can be issued for reservations made through our official website. If you made your reservation through a different website, please inquire how to issue a receipt on that website instead.

Is foreign currency exchange available?
Some locations offer foreign currency exchange machines.
For more information, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at.

Do you provide newspaper delivery services?
No, we do not provide this service.

Is it possible to connect 2 guest rooms?
Some MIMARU locations offer the “Connecting Room” type, which features two standard rooms connected by an internal door.

Are barrier-free rooms available?
Along with fully accessible rooms at select locations, each MIMARU property offers recommended wheelchair-friendly room types, along with universal design access information.

I have reserved two rooms. Is it possible to have them next to each other?
Please let us know about room requests in the “Requests” section when making your reservation, and we will do our utmost to accommodate your wishes.
However, please note that we may not be able to accommodate your request depending on the room availability during your stay.

What rental items are available?
【Kitchen】Rice cookers・Toasters・Additional tableware, etc.
【Bedding】Pajamas・Blankets・Non-feather pillows・Non-feather duvets, etc.
【Others】Irons・Ironing boards・Extension cords・Adapter plugs・Vacuum cleaners・Umbrellas・Nail clippers・Thermometers・Mobile phone charging cables・HDMI cables・Luggage scales, etc.
Available rental items vary by location.

Are rental items for Muslim guests available?
MIMARU offers the following services at all locations:
Rental of halal cooking utensils (knives, cutting boards, and some tableware)
Rental of prayer mats and Qibla compasses
As availability is limited, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at in advance if you require them.

Are rental items for healthcare and welfare available?
We provide items such as shower chairs, bath safety rails, portable safety rails, bath mats, and bed guards for children.

Official important-notice news linked from the hotel page (https://mimaruhotels.com/en/news/info_260528/ 2026-08-16):
【Important Notice】Please Beware of Suspicious Messages Leading to Phishing Websites (2026.05.28)
We have confirmed that some guests who made reservations with us through the accommodation booking website “Booking.com” have received suspicious messages impersonating MIMARU or “Booking.com.”
These messages may be sent through WhatsApp or similar services and may contain unsafe URL links that could direct users to phishing websites.
Please note that MIMARU and Booking.com will never send payment requests or ask guests to access external payment websites without a legitimate reason. If you receive such a message, please do not click on any external links or make any payments.
We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience this situation may cause our guests.
“Phishing websites” are fraudulent websites designed to imitate legitimate websites to steal personal information such as credit card details and account information.
For inquiries to MIMARU, please contact: Cosmos Hotel Management Customer Relation Department customer-mimaru@mimaruhotels.com

【Important Notice】Please Beware of Suspicious Messages Leading to Phishing Websites (2026.05.28)
【Important Notice】Please Beware of Suspicious Messages Leading to Phishing Websites
news
2026.05.28
We have confirmed that some guests who made reservations with us through the accommodation booking website “Booking.com” have received suspicious messages impersonating MIMARU or “Booking.com.”
These messages may be sent through WhatsApp or similar services and may contain unsafe URL links that could direct users to phishing websites.
Please note that MIMARU and Booking.com will never send payment requests or ask guests to access external payment websites without a legitimate reason. If you receive such a message, please do not click on any external links or make any payments.
We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience this situation may cause our guests.
“Phishing websites” are fraudulent websites designed to imitate legitimate websites to steal personal information such as credit card details and account information.
Contact Information
“Booking.com” has established a dedicated customer support contact point regarding this matter. For details about the incident or if you have any questions, please contact their support center.
Booking.com Customer Service　+81-3-6743-6650 (Available 24 hours)
Help Center: https://secure.booking.com/content/cs.html
For inquiries to MIMARU, please contact:
Cosmos Hotel Management Customer Relation Department
customer-mimaru@mimaruhotels.com
• For matters related to reservations:
Please contact the location where you made your reservation directly.
• For general inquiries:
Please contact the Customer Relation Department at customer-mimaru@mimaruhotels.com

Official brand FAQ (https://mimaruhotels.com/en/faq/ 2026-08-16), linked from the official hotel page:

How can I get a receipt?
Receipts can be issued for reservations made through our official website. If you made your reservation through a different website, please inquire how to issue a receipt on that website instead.

If I change the number of people staying, will my reservation price change as well?
If the new number of guests is still within room capacity, there will be no change in reservation price.
Please contact your reserved MIMARU if you would like to change the number of people staying in your room.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I change my check-in date?
You can change reservations that were made through our official website yourself.
However, please note that, depending on room availablity, you may not be able to change to your desired dates.
Additionally, please keep in mind that a price change may occur as each location’s room rates change daily.
 
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact the location you have booked directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I check in early?
If you room is ready, you can check in earlier than 15:00.However, this depends on the room availability on your check-in day, and we are not able to promise an early check-in.

Can I check out late?
Late check-out is available for an additional fee of JPY 3,000 per hour between 11:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
Please note that late check-out is subject to room availability on the day of departure and may not always be possible.

Can I check in late?
Check-in after 22:00 is possible, but please let the location know beforehand that you will be checking in late.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Do you offer luggage delivery services?
Luggage transfer is possible and will be handled by the Japanese postal service, a third party delivery service, or Luggage Delivery by MIMARU. The price will depend on the size and amount of luggage.
Please talk to the front staff about sending out your luggage when you check-in, or at least one day before your check-out date.

Is foreign currency exchange available?
Some locations offer foreign currency exchange machines.
For more information, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I store my luggage before check-in and/or after check-out?
We will store your luggage free of charge between 7:00 and 22:00 on your check-in and check-out days.
Please let the front staff know if you would like to store your luggage.
 
Please note that, due to our limited storage space, there is an additional charge of 500 yen per piece of luggage per day for storing luggage outside of the above hours and days.
We cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.
 
Depending on the space available at the time of your request, we may not be able to accommodate your wish for luggage storage, so please contact each location directly for the details.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

What internet services do you provide?
Every room comes equipped with free Wi-Fi.

Wi-Fi login details are available at check-in.

Do you provide luggage shipping services?
It is possible to send your luggage and belongings to the location in advance.
Please make sure of the following when sending:
 
・Use your MIMARU reservation name for sending. This is required so we know the delivery belongs to you.
・We recommend setting a designated delivery date and arranging the arrival date to be after your check-in date. If your luggage arrives before this date, additional storage fees may apply.
 
Additionally, please note that we cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.
 
Please contact each hotel for more information.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

Do you offer baby crib rental services?
For child safety reasons, we only provide free baby crib services for infants ages 2 below. If you wish to reserve a crib, please make a note on your reservation in the comments section when booking. Please understand in advance that we have a limited number of cribs at each facility.

Do you offer baby cribs and bed guards?
Baby cribs and bed guards are available to rent free of charge.
As availability is limited, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at in advance if you require them. Please note that, for safety reasons, there are age restrictions on these rental items.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Do you provide newspaper delivery services?
No, we do not provide this service.

Is there a humidifier available in each room?
There is a two-in-one air purifying humidifier in each guest room.

I have a nursing infant who is still on baby formula. Is there a way for me to heat water in my room?
All guest rooms are equipped with an electric kettle.

Are there parking lots at your facilities?
MIMARU does not offer dedicated parking lots. If you plan on arriving by car, please inquire at the front desk so our staff can direct you to a nearby parking space. For more parking information, check the “Nearby parking” information at the bottom of each location’s website.
*Guests will have to provide their own parking fees.

What kinds of transportation options are available from the airport to the hotel?
Please refer to the access map under “Directions” at the bottom of each location’s website on how to reach the location from nearby stations and for other information.

Do you provide shuttle bus services from the airport to your hotels?
Unfortunately, we do not provide shuttle bus services.

How do you get from the station to your hotel?
Please refer to the access map under “Directions” at the bottom of each location’s website.

Do you provide breakfast services?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not provide breakfast service.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Does each hotel have a restaurant?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not feature restaurants.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Do you provide room service?
No, we do not provide room service. Please inquire at the hotel reception for dining recommendations in the vicinity of the hotel. Guests are permitted to use food delivery and take-out services at our hotels.

Are minors allowed to book and stay at MIMARU hotels without being accompanied by an adult?
For minors wishing to stay at MIMARU, we require your parent(s) or guardian(s) to fill out and sign our Consent Form for Underage Accommodation using a touchscreen device.
The personal information you provide will be limited to the sole purpose of receiving the consent of your parent(s) and/or guardian(s).
 

The above form will require the use of a touchscreen device. If you do not own a device with touchscreen capabilities, please click here to download and print our consent form, then have it signed by a parent or guardian.

What time is check-in/check out?
・Check-in time: From 3:00PM
・Check-out time: Until 11:00AM
 
Please note that check-outs outside of the above times will incur a fee. We may not be able to accommodate your request depending on room availability.

What is your cancellation policy?
Once you have decided on your plan make a reservation with the “Book” button.
Press “Cancellation Policy” in red text just below the price details on the next screen to display the cancellation policy for this room plan.
 
For more details, please refer to the penalty charges in the “Accommodation Terms and Conditions”.

Can my travel companion check in before me?
Yes, this is possible. Please provide the front desk with the name on the reservation when checking in. Please note that we will be required to confirm the identity of anyone checking in afterwards.

Best Rate Guarantee
“Best rate” refers to the lowest price at the time of booking when comparing our official website’s offer with other online booking sites under the same reservation conditions.

These conditions do not apply to prices in offers in which the hotel is not directly involved, such as auctions, offers by travel businesses/travel agents, and private offers.
Rooms with the same capacity but different rates, etc., are treated as different room types.
If you find a cheaper rate on another website after completing your reservation on our official website, please send a screen capture showing the applicable price, including tax, to the location within 24 hours (after making your reservation).

What are the conditions for the best rate guarantee?
We guarantee the best room rate when the below conditions apply:
Same location
Same accommodation plan
Same reservation dates
Same number of individuals on the reservation
Same room type
Same services, sales conditions, and cancellation policy
 
These conditions apply at the time of booking when comparing the prices on our official webpage to other online booking agents under the exact same booking criteria.

Conditions are not applicable in the case of sales transitions not directly made with the hotel, such as auctions, travel agencies/travel agents, individual sales, etc.
In the case that the accommodation fee differs for two bookings with the same room capacity, the two bookings are treated as differing room types.
If you encounter a cheaper price on another webpage, upon completing your booking on our official webpage, please email the location within 24 hours of booking. Be sure to include a screenshot which lists the accommodation fee (tax included).

Please tell me how to register as a member.
On the search results screen, click the “Sign-in / up” button next to the Membership Rate, or the “Sign-in” button located at the top right corner, then proceed to Create an Account on the following screen.

What are the membership benefits?
【Benefit 1】10% off the Best Rate Plan
【Benefit 2】Earn 1,000 points for each night you stay

I don’t have an email address. Can I still become a member?
An email address is necessary to sign up for the membership program.

I want to update the information I registered with.
You can change your registered information from the My Page (Membership Page).

I want to change my email address.
After logging in to your My Page, you can update your e-mail address from the “Member Information” in the top right corner of the screen.

Is it possible to update registered information over the phone?
Changes to your registered information cannot be made via phone call. Please make any changes from the My Page (Membership Page).

Do you have membership terms and conditions?
Check here for the Terms of Membership

How can I proceed with the cancellation of my membership?
If you would like to cancel your membership, please complete the procedure using the “Delete account” button on the My Page (Membership Page).

Are reservations made on other third-party internet booking sites eligible for the membership program?
This membership program does not apply to reservations made through other reservation websites. Please register as a member and make your reservation through MIMARU’s official website.

When do I receive points?
Points will be added to your account 3 days after you check out. They will expire 2 years after your check-out date. Expired points will be automatically deducted.

Where can I check my points balance?
For details about your accumulated points, please check the My Page (Membership Page).

Please explain how to use points.
To use points, log in to your member account. Once you have decided on an accommodation plan or room and click “Book,” you will be taken to the guest details screen. If you have points available to use, there will be a line here to enter the number of points you wish to use.

Can I use points after making a reservation?
Points cannot be applied after making a reservation. If you would like to use your points, please cancel your reservation and remake it with points applied.

Is it possible to transfer points to others?
Points cannot be transferred.

What happens if I cancel a reservation made using points?
In the event a reservation with points applied is canceled, the points will not be deducted and will be readded to the available total. However, if the points are past their expiration date when the reservation is canceled, they will not be readded.

Is it possible to combine discounts?
Promo codes can still be applied after using the membership discount and/or points.

Are all rooms non-smoking?
All MIMARU rooms are non-smoking.
Please consider using the designated smoking areas if you would like to smoke.
We kindly ask for your cooperation so families with small children staying at MIMARU can have a safe trip.

Is it possible to connect 2 guest rooms?
Some MIMARU locations offer the “Connecting Room” type, which features two standard rooms connected by an internal door.

Are barrier-free rooms available?
Along with fully accessible rooms at select locations, each MIMARU property offers recommended wheelchair-friendly room types, along with universal design access information. Please refer to the page below to find out more details and how to issue special requests:
https://mimaruhotels.com/en/experience/accessible-tourism/

I have reserved two rooms. Is it possible to have them next to each other?
Please let us know about room requests in the “Requests” section when making your reservation, and we will do our utmost to accommodate your wishes.
However, please note that we may not be able to accommodate your request depending on the room availability during your stay.

How are children counted towards room capacity?
Up to 2 children who are of the age of 6 or under at the time of check-in will not be counted towards adult capacity and can share a bed with an adult.
If you have any additional questions, please contact the location you are planning to stay at directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

What rental items are available?
【Kitchen】Rice cookers・Toasters・Additional tableware, etc.
【Bedding】Pajamas・Blankets・Non-feather pillows・Non-feather duvets, etc.
【Others】Irons・Ironing boards・Extension cords・Adapter plugs・Vacuum cleaners・Umbrellas・Nail clippers・Thermometers・Mobile phone charging cables・HDMI cables・Luggage scales, etc.
 
Available rental items vary by location.
For more details please contact the location directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Are rental items for Muslim guests available?
MIMARU offers the following services at all locations:

Rental of halal cooking utensils (knives, cutting boards, and some tableware)
Rental of prayer mats and Qibla compasses
As availability is limited, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at in advance if you require them.

For more information, please refer to the following link:
https://mimaruhotels.com/news/muslim-friendly/

Are rental items for healthcare and welfare available?
We provide items such as shower chairs, bath safety rails, portable safety rails, bath mats, and bed guards for children. For more details, please refer to the following link:
https://mimaruhotels.com/en/experience/accessible-tourism/

Does MIMARU provide amenities?
Each MIMARU location provides shampoo, conditioner, body soap, face and hand soap, dishwashing detergent, kitchen paper, dish sponges, deodorant spray, tissue paper, coffee, and tea bags.

To help protect the environment, we request that you bring your own amenities such as own toothbrushes and slippers. Please inquire at the front desk if these items are needed.

What type of room cleaning services do you provide?
Daily cleaning involves replacing bath towels, face towels, and bath mats, in addition to vacuuming.
During your stay, cleaning services will be provided every two days starting from the third day (excluding the check-in day). The bathroom and all areas except the kitchen will be cleaned, and the beds will be made.
Should you need additional cleaning services (subject to an additional charge), kindly notify the front desk staff ahead of time.

Is there a gym?
A gym is available only at MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo and MIMARU Osaka Namba Station.
For more details, please refer to each hotel’s official webpage.

Do you offer coin laundries?
Coin laundries are available 24/7 at almost all of our locations except the ones that feature a washing machine/dryer in all rooms.

Are there any convenience stores or supermarkets nearby?
All MIMARU locations feature convenient access to nearby major train stations, convenience stores, and supermarkets. Our staff is always happy to give information on the surrounding area, so please don’t hesitate to ask.

MIMARU Tokyo Akasaka is an official apartment hotel at 7-9-6 Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo 107-0052, a 4-minute walk from Akasaka Station (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, Exit 7) and a 14-minute walk from Akasaka-mitsuke Station (Marunouchi / Ginza Lines, Exit 10). Official page: peaceful neighborhood in the heart of Tokyo, for sightseeing or business. Haneda Airport 50 minutes by train and monorail or 35 minutes by taxi; Narita Airport 1 hour 30 minutes by train or 1 hour 15 minutes by taxi.

Official room types (mimaruhotels.com/en/hotel/akasaka/, 16 Aug 2026):
Japanese Apartment — Japanese-Western-style room, 40㎡, single bed ×2 and futon ×2, washbasin ×1, restroom ×1, bathroom ×1, no in-room washer-dryer, adults 4 / children 2 (children ages 6 and under). Room layout cannot be selected. Coin laundry available.
Apartment (Sofa-Bed) — official layout tag Studio, 40㎡, single bed ×2 and sofa bed ×2, washbasin ×1, restroom ×1, bathroom ×1, no in-room washer-dryer, adults 4 / children 2. Suited for two people who want a leisurely stay. Room layout cannot be selected.
City View Apartment (Sofa-Bed) — high-floor studio, 40㎡, single bed ×2 and sofa bed ×2, washbasin ×1, restroom ×1, bathroom ×1, no in-room washer-dryer, adults 4 / children 2. Official copy: lovely view of the city both day and night.
Connecting Japanese Apartment — pair of Japanese-style rooms with a connecting door, 80㎡, single bed ×4, futon ×2, sofa bed ×2, washbasin ×2, restroom ×2, bathroom ×2, no in-room washer-dryer, adults 8 / children 4.

Official kitchen and dining: each room has a completely furnished kitchen and dining area — IH stove, tableware, cutlery, refrigerator, microwave, electric kettle, dish detergent, dish sponge, pot, saucepan, frying pan, bowl, strainer, knife, cutting board, cooking chopsticks, ladle, spatula, kitchen scissors, paper towels, coffee, tea.
Official bath: separate washstand and bath — body soap, shampoo, conditioner, hand soap, bath towels, face towels, bath mat, tissue paper, air freshener. Official note: guests are requested to bring their own toothbrushes and slippers; inquire at the front desk if needed.
Official other facilities: free Wi-Fi, non-smoking, coin laundry, 24-hour security, hair dryer, safety box, TV, air purifier, washlet, international staff, multilingual interpreter app.
Official FAQ: luggage delivery via Japanese postal service, a third-party courier, or Luggage Delivery by MIMARU (price by size/amount; arrange at check-in or at least one day before check-out). Baby cribs and bed guards free to rent, limited availability, book in advance, age restrictions. Cancellation policy is shown on the booking plan after pressing Book. No published nightly or monthly from-rate on the official page. No official minimum stay printed.

Official news linked from the hotel page (https://mimaruhotels.com/en/news/info_260528/ 2026-08-16):
【Important Notice】Please Beware of Suspicious Messages Leading to Phishing Websites (2026.05.28)
【Important Notice】Please Beware of Suspicious Messages Leading to Phishing Websites
news
2026.05.28
We have confirmed that some guests who made reservations with us through the accommodation booking website “Booking.com” have received suspicious messages impersonating MIMARU or “Booking.com.”
These messages may be sent through WhatsApp or similar services and may contain unsafe URL links that could direct users to phishing websites.
Please note that MIMARU and Booking.com will never send payment requests or ask guests to access external payment websites without a legitimate reason. If you receive such a message, please do not click on any external links or make any payments.
We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience this situation may cause our guests.
“Phishing websites” are fraudulent websites designed to imitate legitimate websites to steal personal information such as credit card details and account information.
Contact Information
“Booking.com” has established a dedicated customer support contact point regarding this matter. For details about the incident or if you have any questions, please contact their support center.
Booking.com Customer Service　+81-3-6743-6650 (Available 24 hours)
Help Center: https://secure.booking.com/content/cs.html
For inquiries to MIMARU, please contact:
Cosmos Hotel Management Customer Relation Department
customer-mimaru@mimaruhotels.com
• For matters related to reservations:
Please contact the location where you made your reservation directly.
• For general inquiries:
Please contact the Customer Relation Department at customer-mimaru@mimaruhotels.com

Official brand FAQ (https://mimaruhotels.com/en/faq/ 2026-08-16), linked from the official hotel page:

How can I get a receipt?
Receipts can be issued for reservations made through our official website. If you made your reservation through a different website, please inquire how to issue a receipt on that website instead.

If I change the number of people staying, will my reservation price change as well?
If the new number of guests is still within room capacity, there will be no change in reservation price.
Please contact your reserved MIMARU if you would like to change the number of people staying in your room.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I change my check-in date?
You can change reservations that were made through our official website yourself.
However, please note that, depending on room availablity, you may not be able to change to your desired dates.
Additionally, please keep in mind that a price change may occur as each location’s room rates change daily.
 
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact the location you have booked directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I check in early?
If you room is ready, you can check in earlier than 15:00.However, this depends on the room availability on your check-in day, and we are not able to promise an early check-in.

Can I check out late?
Late check-out is available for an additional fee of JPY 3,000 per hour between 11:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
Please note that late check-out is subject to room availability on the day of departure and may not always be possible.

Can I check in late?
Check-in after 22:00 is possible, but please let the location know beforehand that you will be checking in late.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Do you offer luggage delivery services?
Luggage transfer is possible and will be handled by the Japanese postal service, a third party delivery service, or Luggage Delivery by MIMARU. The price will depend on the size and amount of luggage.
Please talk to the front staff about sending out your luggage when you check-in, or at least one day before your check-out date.

Is foreign currency exchange available?
Some locations offer foreign currency exchange machines.
For more information, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Can I store my luggage before check-in and/or after check-out?
We will store your luggage free of charge between 7:00 and 22:00 on your check-in and check-out days.
Please let the front staff know if you would like to store your luggage.
 
Please note that, due to our limited storage space, there is an additional charge of 500 yen per piece of luggage per day for storing luggage outside of the above hours and days.
We cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.
 
Depending on the space available at the time of your request, we may not be able to accommodate your wish for luggage storage, so please contact each location directly for the details.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

What internet services do you provide?
Every room comes equipped with free Wi-Fi.

Wi-Fi login details are available at check-in.

Do you provide luggage shipping services?
It is possible to send your luggage and belongings to the location in advance.
Please make sure of the following when sending:
 
・Use your MIMARU reservation name for sending. This is required so we know the delivery belongs to you.
・We recommend setting a designated delivery date and arranging the arrival date to be after your check-in date. If your luggage arrives before this date, additional storage fees may apply.
 
Additionally, please note that we cannot store valuables, fragile items, or food.
 
Please contact each hotel for more information.
You can find each hotel’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

Do you offer baby crib rental services?
For child safety reasons, we only provide free baby crib services for infants ages 2 below. If you wish to reserve a crib, please make a note on your reservation in the comments section when booking. Please understand in advance that we have a limited number of cribs at each facility.

Do you offer baby cribs and bed guards?
Baby cribs and bed guards are available to rent free of charge.
As availability is limited, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at in advance if you require them. Please note that, for safety reasons, there are age restrictions on these rental items.
 
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Do you provide newspaper delivery services?
No, we do not provide this service.

Is there a humidifier available in each room?
There is a two-in-one air purifying humidifier in each guest room.

I have a nursing infant who is still on baby formula. Is there a way for me to heat water in my room?
All guest rooms are equipped with an electric kettle.

Are there parking lots at your facilities?
MIMARU does not offer dedicated parking lots. If you plan on arriving by car, please inquire at the front desk so our staff can direct you to a nearby parking space. For more parking information, check the “Nearby parking” information at the bottom of each location’s website.
*Guests will have to provide their own parking fees.

What kinds of transportation options are available from the airport to the hotel?
Please refer to the access map under “Directions” at the bottom of each location’s website on how to reach the location from nearby stations and for other information.

Do you provide shuttle bus services from the airport to your hotels?
Unfortunately, we do not provide shuttle bus services.

How do you get from the station to your hotel?
Please refer to the access map under “Directions” at the bottom of each location’s website.

Do you provide breakfast services?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not provide breakfast service.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Does each hotel have a restaurant?
Unfortunately, MIMARU does not feature restaurants.
However, please don’t hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations in the location’s vicinity.

Do you provide room service?
No, we do not provide room service. Please inquire at the hotel reception for dining recommendations in the vicinity of the hotel. Guests are permitted to use food delivery and take-out services at our hotels.

Are minors allowed to book and stay at MIMARU hotels without being accompanied by an adult?
For minors wishing to stay at MIMARU, we require your parent(s) or guardian(s) to fill out and sign our Consent Form for Underage Accommodation using a touchscreen device.
The personal information you provide will be limited to the sole purpose of receiving the consent of your parent(s) and/or guardian(s).
 

The above form will require the use of a touchscreen device. If you do not own a device with touchscreen capabilities, please click here to download and print our consent form, then have it signed by a parent or guardian.

What time is check-in/check out?
・Check-in time: From 3:00PM
・Check-out time: Until 11:00AM
 
Please note that check-outs outside of the above times will incur a fee. We may not be able to accommodate your request depending on room availability.

What is your cancellation policy?
Once you have decided on your plan make a reservation with the “Book” button.
Press “Cancellation Policy” in red text just below the price details on the next screen to display the cancellation policy for this room plan.
 
For more details, please refer to the penalty charges in the “Accommodation Terms and Conditions”.

Can my travel companion check in before me?
Yes, this is possible. Please provide the front desk with the name on the reservation when checking in. Please note that we will be required to confirm the identity of anyone checking in afterwards.

Best Rate Guarantee
“Best rate” refers to the lowest price at the time of booking when comparing our official website’s offer with other online booking sites under the same reservation conditions.

These conditions do not apply to prices in offers in which the hotel is not directly involved, such as auctions, offers by travel businesses/travel agents, and private offers.
Rooms with the same capacity but different rates, etc., are treated as different room types.
If you find a cheaper rate on another website after completing your reservation on our official website, please send a screen capture showing the applicable price, including tax, to the location within 24 hours (after making your reservation).

What are the conditions for the best rate guarantee?
We guarantee the best room rate when the below conditions apply:
Same location
Same accommodation plan
Same reservation dates
Same number of individuals on the reservation
Same room type
Same services, sales conditions, and cancellation policy
 
These conditions apply at the time of booking when comparing the prices on our official webpage to other online booking agents under the exact same booking criteria.

Conditions are not applicable in the case of sales transitions not directly made with the hotel, such as auctions, travel agencies/travel agents, individual sales, etc.
In the case that the accommodation fee differs for two bookings with the same room capacity, the two bookings are treated as differing room types.
If you encounter a cheaper price on another webpage, upon completing your booking on our official webpage, please email the location within 24 hours of booking. Be sure to include a screenshot which lists the accommodation fee (tax included).

Please tell me how to register as a member.
On the search results screen, click the “Sign-in / up” button next to the Membership Rate, or the “Sign-in” button located at the top right corner, then proceed to Create an Account on the following screen.

What are the membership benefits?
【Benefit 1】10% off the Best Rate Plan
【Benefit 2】Earn 1,000 points for each night you stay

I don’t have an email address. Can I still become a member?
An email address is necessary to sign up for the membership program.

I want to update the information I registered with.
You can change your registered information from the My Page (Membership Page).

I want to change my email address.
After logging in to your My Page, you can update your e-mail address from the “Member Information” in the top right corner of the screen.

Is it possible to update registered information over the phone?
Changes to your registered information cannot be made via phone call. Please make any changes from the My Page (Membership Page).

Do you have membership terms and conditions?
Check here for the Terms of Membership

How can I proceed with the cancellation of my membership?
If you would like to cancel your membership, please complete the procedure using the “Delete account” button on the My Page (Membership Page).

Are reservations made on other third-party internet booking sites eligible for the membership program?
This membership program does not apply to reservations made through other reservation websites. Please register as a member and make your reservation through MIMARU’s official website.

When do I receive points?
Points will be added to your account 3 days after you check out. They will expire 2 years after your check-out date. Expired points will be automatically deducted.

Where can I check my points balance?
For details about your accumulated points, please check the My Page (Membership Page).

Please explain how to use points.
To use points, log in to your member account. Once you have decided on an accommodation plan or room and click “Book,” you will be taken to the guest details screen. If you have points available to use, there will be a line here to enter the number of points you wish to use.

Can I use points after making a reservation?
Points cannot be applied after making a reservation. If you would like to use your points, please cancel your reservation and remake it with points applied.

Is it possible to transfer points to others?
Points cannot be transferred.

What happens if I cancel a reservation made using points?
In the event a reservation with points applied is canceled, the points will not be deducted and will be readded to the available total. However, if the points are past their expiration date when the reservation is canceled, they will not be readded.

Is it possible to combine discounts?
Promo codes can still be applied after using the membership discount and/or points.

Are all rooms non-smoking?
All MIMARU rooms are non-smoking.
Please consider using the designated smoking areas if you would like to smoke.
We kindly ask for your cooperation so families with small children staying at MIMARU can have a safe trip.

Is it possible to connect 2 guest rooms?
Some MIMARU locations offer the “Connecting Room” type, which features two standard rooms connected by an internal door.

Are barrier-free rooms available?
Along with fully accessible rooms at select locations, each MIMARU property offers recommended wheelchair-friendly room types, along with universal design access information. Please refer to the page below to find out more details and how to issue special requests:
https://mimaruhotels.com/en/experience/accessible-tourism/

I have reserved two rooms. Is it possible to have them next to each other?
Please let us know about room requests in the “Requests” section when making your reservation, and we will do our utmost to accommodate your wishes.
However, please note that we may not be able to accommodate your request depending on the room availability during your stay.

How are children counted towards room capacity?
Up to 2 children who are of the age of 6 or under at the time of check-in will not be counted towards adult capacity and can share a bed with an adult.
If you have any additional questions, please contact the location you are planning to stay at directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the Google Map.

What rental items are available?
【Kitchen】Rice cookers・Toasters・Additional tableware, etc.
【Bedding】Pajamas・Blankets・Non-feather pillows・Non-feather duvets, etc.
【Others】Irons・Ironing boards・Extension cords・Adapter plugs・Vacuum cleaners・Umbrellas・Nail clippers・Thermometers・Mobile phone charging cables・HDMI cables・Luggage scales, etc.
 
Available rental items vary by location.
For more details please contact the location directly.
You can find each location’s email address on their respective pages at the bottom under “Directions” next to the google map.

Are rental items for Muslim guests available?
MIMARU offers the following services at all locations:

Rental of halal cooking utensils (knives, cutting boards, and some tableware)
Rental of prayer mats and Qibla compasses
As availability is limited, please contact the MIMARU you plan to stay at in advance if you require them.

For more information, please refer to the following link:
https://mimaruhotels.com/news/muslim-friendly/

Are rental items for healthcare and welfare available?
We provide items such as shower chairs, bath safety rails, portable safety rails, bath mats, and bed guards for children. For more details, please refer to the following link:
https://mimaruhotels.com/en/experience/accessible-tourism/

Does MIMARU provide amenities?
Each MIMARU location provides shampoo, conditioner, body soap, face and hand soap, dishwashing detergent, kitchen paper, dish sponges, deodorant spray, tissue paper, coffee, and tea bags.

To help protect the environment, we request that you bring your own amenities such as own toothbrushes and slippers. Please inquire at the front desk if these items are needed.

What type of room cleaning services do you provide?
Daily cleaning involves replacing bath towels, face towels, and bath mats, in addition to vacuuming.
During your stay, cleaning services will be provided every two days starting from the third day (excluding the check-in day). The bathroom and all areas except the kitchen will be cleaned, and the beds will be made.
Should you need additional cleaning services (subject to an additional charge), kindly notify the front desk staff ahead of time.

Is there a gym?
A gym is available only at MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo and MIMARU Osaka Namba Station.
For more details, please refer to each hotel’s official webpage.

Coin laundries are available 24/7 at almost all of our locations except the ones that feature a washing machine/dryer in all rooms.

news
2026.05.28
We have confirmed that some guests who made reservations with us through the accommodation booking website “Booking.com” have received suspicious messages impersonating MIMARU or “Booking.com.”
These messages may be sent through WhatsApp or similar services and may contain unsafe URL links that could direct users to phishing websites.
Please note that MIMARU and Booking.com will never send payment requests or ask guests to access external payment websites without a legitimate reason. If you receive such a message, please do not click on any external links or make any payments.
We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience this situation may cause our guests.
“Phishing websites” are fraudulent websites designed to imitate legitimate websites to steal personal information such as credit card details and account information.
